title: Data and code for: Regional heterothermy in Megasoma gyas is not related to active heat dissipation by the horns
description:
Data and R code for the thermal-imaging study testing whether the horns of the rhinoceros beetle Megasoma gyas act as heat-dissipation structures. Contains per-individual cooling rates for four body regions under passive heating and control treatments, together with body mass and proportional horn size, and the RMarkdown analysis that reproduces every model and figure.

Supplement to: Regional heterothermy in Megasoma gyas is not related to active heat dissipation by the horns. Insect Science 33(3): 1206–1210. doi:10.1111/1744-7917.70018
